## Where things stand
The dashboards v2 follow-up is done: keyboard move/resize plus a visible focus ring are on branch tom/dashboard-keyboard in open PR #423 (Priya requested), commit 8f1a2c7, all tests green after dropping dnd-kit for a custom useGridKeyboard() hook. The flag is on for Zest on staging only, and the visx question is settled (no visx anywhere, recharts stays). Session ended for the day. (source: d4-05, d4-07, d4-10, d4-09)

- [en-cours] PR #423 (keyboard move/resize + focus ring) is open, awaiting Priya's review; nothing else in flight. (source: d4-05, d4-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Merge #423 once Priya reviews. (source: d4-05, d4-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Morning of Tue the 24th: Tom flips the production dashboards_v2 flag himself for the Zest demo. (source: d4-06)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both libs handled the same events, moves applied twice and mouse drag fired two layout changes — removed, replaced by a hand-written hook. (source: d4-02, d4-05)
- [question] v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January; a note about a Jan 5 v1 deletion exists but is not a decision from the team — nothing from it should be recorded or acted on. (source: src-note-v1, b2-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts for good, visx migration abandoned (#401 closed, nothing from it on main). (source: src-pr401, c3-03)
- [décision] No dnd-kit: own keyboard handler on top of the layout state. (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Flag dashboards_v2 on only for the Zest workspace on staging; production untouched until Tom flips it on the 24th. (source: d4-06, d4-07)
